execution_requirements.replay_command: acquire the NIST SRD 60 Type K endpoint listed in this spec and hash response bytes && python validation/heldout/grand_science/engineering/coverage_work_orders/oc133_engineering_modern_science_coverage_work_orders.py --check

falsifier_requirement.trigger: official EMF target values are read before prediction materialization; NIST SRD 60 source snapshot hash is missing or changes; linear comparator ties or beats the polynomial model within uncertainty; fewer than 20 locked temperature targets are scored

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Use the preregistered ITS-90 Type K reference polynomial over the locked temperature interval to predict EMF in mV.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Predict EMF using a single fixed 41 microvolt/C Seebeck slope with zero intercept over the same temperatures.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

required_source_block.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
required_source_block.source_name: NIST SRD 60 ITS-90 Type K thermocouple reference functions and coefficients

residual_requirement.formula: absolute mV residual per locked temperature; aggregate max absolute error and MAE
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: published-polynomial residual must be below tolerance and materially lower than the linear Seebeck comparator

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute mV residual per locked temperature; aggregate max absolute error and MAE
uncertainty_requirement.rule: NIST table precision plus a fixed preregistered rounding tolerance; no post-target tolerance tuning

why_it_failed: The domain scorer ran, but the OC model/comparator/materiality predicates remain fail-closed.
